mapper.select: select wr.id, wr.course_id, null custom_course_id, c.title course_title, wr.duration_minutes, wr.completion_percent, wr.started_at, wr.completed_at from workout_records wr join courses c on c.id = wr.course_id where wr.id = #{id} and wr.user_id = #{userId}

select cwr.id, null course_id, cwr.custom_course_id, cc.title course_title, cwr.duration_minutes, cwr.completion_percent, cwr.started_at, cwr.completed_at from custom_workout_records cwr join custom_courses cc on cc.id = cwr.custom_course_id where cwr.id = #{id} and cwr.user_id = #{userId}

select * from ( select wr.id, wr.course_id, null custom_course_id, c.title course_title, wr.duration_minutes, wr.completion_percent, wr.started_at, wr.completed_at from workout_records wr join courses c on c.id = wr.course_id where wr.user_id = #{userId} union all select cwr.id, null course_id, cwr.custom_course_id, cc.title course_title, cwr.duration_minutes, cwr.completion_percent, cwr.started_at, cwr.completed_at from custom_workout_records cwr join custom_courses cc on cc.id = cwr.custom_course_id where cwr.user_id = #{userId} ) history order by completed_at desc limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: select training_date, active_seconds from training_activity where user_id = #{userId} union all select cast(wr.completed_at as date), wr.duration_minutes * 60 from workout_records wr where wr.user_id = #{userId} and not exists (select 1 from training_activity a where a.user_id = wr.user_id and a.activity_type = 'COURSE' and a.item_id = wr.course_id and a.started_at = wr.started_at) union all select cast(wr.completed_at as date), wr.duration_minutes * 60 from custom_workout_records wr where wr.user_id = #{userId} and not exists (select 1 from training_activity a where a.user_id = wr.user_id and a.activity_type = 'CUSTOM_COURSE' and a.item_id = wr.custom_course_id and a.started_at = wr.started_at)
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from workout_records where user_id = #{userId} and completion_percent >= 80) + (select count(*) from custom_workout_records where user_id = #{userId} and completion_percent >= 80) completed_count, floor(coalesce(sum(active_seconds), 0) / 60) total_minutes from () history
select distinct training_date from () history where active_seconds > 0 order by training_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into training_activity(user_id, activity_type, item_id, started_at, training_date, active_seconds) values (#{userId}, #{activity.activityType}, #{activity.itemId}, #{activity.startedAt}, #{activity.trainingDate}, #{activity.activeSeconds}) on duplicate key update active_seconds = greatest(active_seconds, values(active_seconds))
insert into training_detail_visits(user_id, detail_type, item_id) values (#{userId}, #{detailType}, #{itemId})
